lawyer:
Mr. Kamal Hossain, Advocate, For the petitioners 
Mr. Md. Mizanur Rahman, Advocate, For the opposite parties.
parties:
Rezia Bewa and others
Vs.
Md. Tamizuddin and others.
full_judgment: 8. The learned Advocate appearing on behalf of the petitioners submits that, the learned Appellate Court during disposal of the appeal committed illegality and irregularity and without complying with the provisions laid down in Order XLI rule 31 of the Code of Civil Procedure passed the impugned judgment and decree. The learned Advocate further submits that, the impugned judgment and decree is not a proper judgment of reversal inasmuch as the learned court of appeal below erred in law without adverting evidence and giving reasonings in support of its findings and decision. The learned Advocate also submits that in a suit for easement right the plaintiffs will have to file the suit against the servient owner, but in the instant case the plaintiffs did not institute the suit against the servient owner and as such, it is barred by law. The learned Advocate argued that, it has been contended by the plaintiffs in their plaint that the defendants threatened their possession, but without filing a suit for injunction, they have erroneously filed the suit for declaration of easement right and the learned trial court rightly dismissed the suit on contest. The learned Advocate lastly submits that the appellate court below without reversing the findings of the trial court adverting evidence on records illegally reversed the judgment and decree passed by the learned Assistant Judge, Kalihati, Tangail and as such the impugned judgment and decree deserve interference of this Court.
